description: This file implements the GroupService interface with business logic for managing Group entities, including listing groups by type and IDs. It uses dependency injection for the GroupDao and handles exceptions by wrapping them in a ServiceException.

classes.name: GroupServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the GroupService interface providing methods to list groups by type and IDs, using a DAO for database interaction.

methods.name: listGroup
methods.description: Returns a list of groups filtered by the specified GroupType, handling exceptions by throwing a ServiceException.

methods.name: listGroupByIds
methods.description: Returns a list of groups corresponding to the given set of IDs, with error handling via ServiceException.
